text:
sara: morning all :wave: quick async standup — model-rollout warmup + capacity notes

sara: what I did yesterday: finished the warmup script for the rtx-80k variant, verified KV cache behavior on short sequences, ran a dry-run in us-east1 (50 concurrent reqs) — latency looked stable (~38ms P50).

sara: blockers: eu-west quotas still at 68% of target, can't prewarm the private pool there; need a temporary bump or a fallback plan. also seeing a small spike in prewarm failures when spot-backed nodes are used (~4/100).

sara: today: request quota bump if possible, coordinate prewarm window, and finalize autoscale policy for the rollout.

devon: noted — current fleet dashboard shows us-west2 82% used, eu-west1 69% used. If we start warmup in eu-west1 we'll cross 80% unless we shift some traffic.

devon: can we reduce prewarm batch size from 200 -> 100 for eu to spread out ramp?

irina: agreed on reducing batch size. i'll update the warmup job to `--batch-size=100` and add a 20s jitter between jobs. should cut peak a bit.

irina: also propose reserving 10 gpus in eu-west1 as "prewarm-only" for 2hr window, then release. that keeps tail latency predictable.

mike: for the quota bump, please file an infra-req with the subject: "temporary-gpu-bump-eu-west1-+10-hrs" and tag @cloud-finance. sample payload below: 

```
infra-req create --region eu-west1 --resource nvidia-a100 --quantity 10 --duration 2h --reason "rtx-80k warmup/rollout" --notify @cloud-finance,@eng-infra
```

mike: i'll watch the ticket and approve cust-limits if cloud-finance signs off. also FYI i'll flip the spot-eviction tolerance to conservative for the warmup window so prewarm nodes don't get reclaimed.

ops-bot: schedule update: spot-eviction-drill planned 2024-11-07T22:00Z — this conflicts with requested warmup windows if we schedule after that. :information_source:

devon: good catch. let's avoid warmup during the drill window. sara, what's the intended warmup start ETA?

sara: aiming to start eu-west1 warmup ~2024-11-07T02:00Z (2am local) — so that's well before the drill. if we get the +10 GPUs for 2h we should be fine.

irina: i'll stage the job with `--start=2024-11-07T02:00Z` and dry-run it tonight against a small canned set.

mike: small ops note — please add the rollout tag `model/rtx-80k/rolling-warmup` to the ticket so tracing and cost center attribution work.

sara: done. filing infra-req now and pinging cloud-finance. thanks team :thumbsup:

devon: acked. i'll reroute low-priority batch jobs out of eu-west1 during the 2h window to free headroom.

irina: no further blockers from my side. i'll post the job snippet in the ticket once it's staged.

mike: i'll monitor fleet usage and escalate if we see >88% utilization.

ops-bot: reminder: please annotate ticket with `prewarm: true` and include the warmup config hash for auditing.

sara: wrap-up: filed ticket, reduced planned batch size, prewarm-only reservation proposed, avoiding drill window. will update later if cloud-finance approves. :eyes:
